source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with misty mountains, lakeside settlements, wooded rocky banks, boats, scholars, and foreground pavilions. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: central_misty_mountain_range
motifs.description: Isolate the large central background mountain range: overlapping steep peaks rising from horizontal mist, with pale ink-and-color washes, darker contour strokes, wrinkled rock texture, dotted vegetation on ridges, and soft atmospheric edges at the base.
must_preserve: horizontal mist bands separating mountain bases

motifs.name: left_distant_hills_in_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant hills at the upper-left landscape area, including low triangular and rounded mountain forms emerging through haze behind the nearer shore.

motifs.name: left_foreground_rocky_wooded_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground rocky hillside descending toward the lake, with exposed striated rocks, clustered dark shrubs, slender trunks, conifers, and autumn-colored foliage on the slope.
must_preserve: slender tree trunks following the slope
mist-softened transition to water at the right edge

motifs.name: scholars_beneath_autumn_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left scholar gathering beneath tall autumn trees: two robed figures seated or standing on a small rocky terrace, framed by vertical trunks, red-brown foliage, and nearby stones.
must_preserve: delicate black head and sleeve linework
vertical tree trunks with textured bark
quiet negative space around the figures

motifs.name: lakeside_village_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-distance lakeside village and pine grove on the far shore: low roofed houses and pavilions nestled among many straight trees, with a narrow bank and calm water in front.

motifs.name: midriver_covered_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small covered boat floating near the middle of the lake, including its long hull, low cabin canopy, stern shape, and faint ripples beneath it.

motifs.name: right_foreground_pavilion_willow_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground shore with a small roofed pavilion tucked under dense trees and willow branches, plus the adjacent rocks, bank, and shallow waterline.
must_preserve: reeds and grasses along the water

motifs.name: lower_right_boat_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right boat scene: a narrow boat close to shore carrying small figures, with pale sails or cloth shapes, bank grasses, nearby rocks, and shallow water strokes.
must_preserve: pale triangular cloth or sail accents
low rock forms beside the water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
